goal: 从本地仓库两个提交或粘贴 diff 生成可复现的冻结审核输入。

interface_contracts.name: snapshot
interface_contracts.definition: core.snapshot: FrozenFile(side: str, path: str, text: str|None, oid: str, mode: str); TestEvidence(commit: str, command: tuple[str,...], exit_code: int, log: str); FrozenSnapshot(repository: str|None, baseline: str|None, candidate: str|None, diff: str, requirements: str, acceptance: tuple[str,...], tests: tuple[TestEvidence,...], files: tuple[FrozenFile,...]); frozen dataclasses. snapshot_id property SHA256 canonical JSON of all fields; to_dict()->dict; from_dict(dict)->FrozenSnapshot trusted codec. FrozenSnapshot 最后还有 required_tests: tuple[tuple[str,...],...]=()，进入哈希，是用户声明必须通过的完整命令集合。

interface_contracts.name: CLI input boundary
interface_contracts.definition: cli.snapshot: freeze_repository(repo: Path, baseline: str, candidate: str, requirements: str, acceptance: tuple[str,...], tests: tuple[TestEvidence,...]=())->FrozenSnapshot; freeze_diff(diff: str, requirements: str, acceptance: tuple[str,...])->FrozenSnapshot; materialize(snapshot: FrozenSnapshot, destination: Path)->None writes base/candidate text trees (baseline/ candidate/), symlinks as inert text and no .git, no executable code. Strict user input validation at CLI boundary. All Git subprocesses argv, no shell, no hooks/external diff/textconv. Files from commits not working tree; preserve binary metadata and symlink mode; path traversal rejected. freeze_repository 增加 keyword-only required_tests: tuple[tuple[str,...],...]=()。

deliverables: 从本地仓库两个提交或粘贴 diff 生成可复现的冻结审核输入。
docs/deliveries/T-0010.md：开工 HEAD、验收对应、路径、检查与限制
acceptance_criteria: unit：同样输入哈希相同；任一提交、diff、需求、验收或测试日志变动影响哈希；工作树污染不改变冻结结果。
unit：两侧文件及删除/重命名正确、仅从提交读取；畸形引用、路径、测试证据被 CLI 边界拒绝；Git 命令使用 argv。
unit：materialize 不跟随仓库 symlink、不创建 .git、不读取工作树；支持空仓库差异和 binary 标记；diff-only 明确无仓库和测试。
完整 verify；交付说明列出边界限制。
